summary: Fase 1C Offertegenerator 2.0 fully tested (backend + frontend). 11/11 backend tests pass (1 skipped — project always gets lead_id), all critical UI flows work. Found and fixed 1 backend bug: WorkItem model was missing default_source field, causing the value to be silently stripped on werkpost creation.

minor.issue: response_model=LineItem strips source/work_item_id fields from JSON response (values are stored in DB and learning logic still works, but frontend cannot read them back). Main agent already flagged this.

action_items: Optional: Adjust /api/quotes/{id}/items to include source + work_item_id in the response_model so the frontend can re-render bron-labels when reopening an existing quote (current behavior keeps data in DB only).
Optional: validate the /create-quote 400 path for projects without lead_id via a direct DB seed, since POST /api/projects auto-creates a lead.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED — WorkItem model in /app/backend/werkposten.py was missing the default_source field while WorkItemCreate/WorkItemUpdate had it. Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='ignore') silently dropped the field on insert, so the new 'Standaard hoeveelheid-bron' selector on the werkpost form never persisted anything. Added default_source: Optional[str] = None to WorkItem.
/api/quotes/{id}/items strips offerte-generator-specific fields (source, work_item_id) via response_model=LineItem — consider exposing them so the UI can show bron-labels on the line items list.
offerte_generator.py is 538 lines and aggregates 3 concerns (templates CRUD, suggest, create-quote). Still readable, but watch for further growth (>700 lines threshold).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (template CRUD, generator flow, quote creation, werkpost default_source field all OK)

seed_data_creation: Test data is created and cleaned up within tests (TEST_ prefixed werkposten and templates). Live created quotes (OFF-2026-09CE0E etc.) remain in DB; not cleaned up because main agent did not provide a delete endpoint test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_offerte_generator.py and require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var to be passed when running pytest from outside the supervisor environment. Auth uses /api/auth2/login (NOT /api/auth/login). PROJ-60A4159C is a reusable seeded project with a Badkamer meetstaat. The Werkpost API exposes default_source after the bug fix in werkposten.py.
rca of the issue: WorkItem (read schema) used ConfigDict(extra='ignore'), so when create_werkpost() instantiated WorkItem(**WorkItemCreate.model_dump()), the default_source key in the dict was discarded before insert. Pydantic v2 silently ignores unknown fields with this config, so no error surfaced. Fix: declare default_source: Optional[str] = None on the WorkItem model. Verified via pytest TestWerkpostDefaultSource: create → returned + GET both now include default_source='floor_area'.
